closedDefect.defect: the Handoff Preview gated events on ONE flag, so SESSION_CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED + dshSessionId:null + ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT exposed the page's events

wiring: buildHandoffPreview now also requires validateAdmissionInvariants to pass before events enter the execution view; the refused case is reported through eventsDetail
designNote: a small pure validator rather than a general-purpose state machine; the ruling explicitly asks for this shape and warns against relying solely on the composition always supplying self-consistent fields
tests: P2C C5 §8.5 the canonical contradictory combination is refused
P2C C5 §8.5 BOUND_VERIFIED with a null session id is refused
P2C C5 §8.5 a page whose session differs from the binding is refused
P2C §11.5 invalid binding-state combinations cannot expose events
